title: Erdos #1015 OQ1: Exact Values of f(t) for Small t >= 4

problemStatement.formal: \forall t \ge 4, \exists x < t, f(t) = R(t, t-1) + x. \text{Determine } x.
problemStatement.plain: Determine the exact BES remainder x in f(t) = R(t,t-1) + x for t = 4,5. We prove f(4) ∈ {9,10,11,12} and f(5) ∈ {25,...,29} but the exact remainder is open.
whyMatters: Pinning down the BES remainder requires analyzing extremal 2-colorings of complete graphs
The exact values of f(4) and f(5) are the simplest open cases of the BES formula

proven: From the stated axioms, f(4) lies in the BES window {9, 10, 11, 12}.
From the stated axioms, f(5) lies in the BES window {25, 26, 27, 28, 29}.
From the stated axioms, f(t) has exponential lower growth and is not O(t).
